text: The caller now invokes account verification, selects Mail and awaits post-wizard initialization unconditionally in its account-based branch. Verification returns no Boolean. Direct tests check initialization before and after creating an IMAP account, but accepted tests later remove the original domWindow identity assertion. The session _restored flag is explicitly set before tabs finish loading, so it is a limited state assertion rather than complete application readiness.
title: First-run mail initialization no longer depends on the verifier's Boolean result
